capabilities: show a floating toolbar above the text selection
toggle bold and italic on the selection
set or clear heading levels H1–H6 on selected lines
apply and remove six colored highlights using inline mark tags
dismiss the toolbar via Escape, scrolling, or clicking elsewhere
problem: Applying formatting in Obsidian requires remembering keyboard shortcuts or opening menus; there is no contextual toolbar that appears when text is selected.
summary: Floating formatting toolbar that pops up over selected text with bold, italic, heading levels H1–H6, and six colored highlights.
